title: Children in Training Classes
synopsis: Read about the phenomenon of training classes for children in China.

fullText.simplified:
培训班的孩子们

    “不能让孩子输在起跑线上”这句话影响了中国父母很多年。近些年，城市的父母圈又流行一句话：“拼爹的时代，你的孩子早已输在起跑线上了。”这句话的意思就是父母实力不够强，孩子的起点就已经比别人低了。
    其实，这句话说得有点儿夸张了。以中国的一线城市为例，虽然大多数父母都是工薪阶层，但是家庭生活质量一点都不差，经济条件绝对能满足孩子的教育支出。所以通过这句话也能看出中国父母“望子成龙”的焦虑心态。
    为了让那些所谓起点低的孩子赶上来，父母们用了各种方法。其中最常用的就是上培训班，而且培训班的种类也是五花八门。三门主科：数学、语文和英语必不可少，其他的还有什么画画的、音乐的、运动的、计算机的等等。
    从幼儿园到高中毕业，城市里的每个孩子几乎都上过培训班。连一岁多的孩子都开始上培训班了，学习语言、画画等内容。孩子们除了上课外，周末还要早起晚归，有的孩子甚至早上六点半就起床，一天都待在培训班，直到晚上七点以后才回家。不仅孩子们像赶场一样，从一个培训班换到另一个培训班，就连家长的时间也完全被占用了。
    即使是这样，家长们还是乐此不疲，因为他们相信孩子只有不断地学习才能变得更好，成为最厉害的人。很多人认为出现这种情况的原因是现在竞争太激烈了，父母们不得不逼着孩子学更多知识，否则就有可能被社会淘汰。不管怎么样，还是希望父母们放轻松，给自己和孩子的压力都小一点，让孩子们好好享受童年时光！
fullText.traditional:
培訓班的孩子們

    “不能讓孩子輸在起跑線上”這句話影響了中國父母很多年。近些年，城市的父母圈又流行一句話：“拼爹的時代，你的孩子早已輸在起跑線上了。”這句話的意思就是父母實力不夠強，孩子的起點就已經比別人低了。
    其實，這句話說得有點兒誇張了。以中國的一線城市為例，雖然大多數父母都是工薪階層，但是家庭生活質量一點都不差，經濟條件絕對能滿足孩子的教育支出。所以通過這句話也能看出中國父母“望子成龍”的焦慮心態。
    為了讓那些所謂起點低的孩子趕上來，父母們用了各種方法。其中最常用的就是上培訓班，而且培訓班的種類也是五花八門。三門主科：數學、語文和英語必不可少，其他的還有什麼畫畫的、音樂的、運動的、計算機的等等。
    從幼兒園到高中畢業，城市裡的每個孩子幾乎都上過培訓班。連一歲多的孩子都開始上培訓班了，學習語言、畫畫等內容。孩子們除了上課外，週末還要早起晚歸，有的孩子甚至早上六點半就起床，一天都待在培訓班，直到晚上七點以後才回家。不僅孩子們像趕場一樣，從一個培訓班換到另一個培訓班，就連家長的時間也完全被佔用了。
    即使是這樣，家長們還是樂此不疲，因為他們相信孩子只有不斷地學習才能變得更好，成為最厲害的人。很多人認為出現這種情況的原因是現在競爭太激烈了，父母們不得不逼著孩子學更多知識，否則就有可能被社會淘汰。不管怎麼樣，還是希望父母們放輕鬆，給自己和孩子的壓力都小一點，讓孩子們好好享受童年時光！

sentences.english: From kindergarten to high school graduation, almost every child living in cities will attend training classes.

sentences.simplified: 孩子们除了上课外，周末还要早起晚归，
sentences.traditional: 孩子們除了上課外，週末還要早起晚歸，

sentences.simplified: 有的孩子甚至早上六点半就起床，一天都待在培训班，直到晚上七点以后才回家。
sentences.traditional: 有的孩子甚至早上六點半就起床，一天都待在培訓班，直到晚上七點以後才回家。

sentences.english: As well as attending classes, kids also get up early and come home late on weekends.

sentences.simplified: 不仅孩子们像赶场一样，从一个培训班换到另一个培训班，就连家长的时间也完全被占用了。

sentences.english: Some kids even get up at 6:30 am, spend the whole day in training classes, and don’t get home until after 7:00 pm.
Not only are the kids rushing from one training class to another, their parents’ time is also completely occupied.

sentences.simplified: 即使是这样，家长们还是乐此不疲，
sentences.traditional: 即使是這樣，家長們還是樂此不疲，

sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā men xiāng xìn hái zi zhǐ yǒu bú duàn de xué xí cái néng biàn de gèng hǎo chéng wéi zuì lì hai de rén
sentences.english: Even so, parents still do not tire of it, ..

sentences.simplified: 很多人认为出现这种情况的原因是现在竞争太激烈了，
sentences.traditional: 很多人認為出現這種情況的原因是現在競爭太激烈了，

sentences.english: .. since they believe that only through continuous study can their children improve, and become outstanding people.

sentences.simplified: 父母们不得不逼着孩子学更多知识，否则就有可能被社会淘汰。
sentences.traditional: 父母們不得不逼著孩子學更多知識，否則就有可能被社會淘汰。
sentences.pinyin: fù mǔ men bù dé bù bī zhe hái zi xué gèng duō zhī shi fǒu zé jiù yǒu kě néng bèi shè huì táo tài
sentences.english: Many people think that the occurrence of this situation is rooted in excessively intense competition nowadays.

sentences.simplified: 不管怎么样，还是希望父母们放轻松，给自己和孩子的压力都小一点，
sentences.traditional: 不管怎麼樣，還是希望父母們放輕鬆，給自己和孩子的壓力都小一點，
sentences.pinyin: bù guǎn zěn me yàng hái shi xī wàng fù mǔ men fàng qīng sōng gěi zì jǐ hé hái zi de yā lì dōu xiǎo yì diǎn
sentences.english: Parents have no choice but to force their kids to learn more knowledge; otherwise, they may be eliminated by society.

sentences.simplified: 让孩子们好好享受童年时光！
sentences.traditional: 讓孩子們好好享受童年時光！
sentences.pinyin: ràng hái zi men hǎo hǎo xiǎng shòu tóng nián shí guāng
sentences.english: No matter what, we hope that parents can relax and ease the pressure on themselves and their children a little, ..
.. so that their children can enjoy their childhood.

raw.synopsis: Read about the phenomenon of training classes for children in China.
sentence_translations: Children in Training Classes
The saying “Don’t let your kids lose at the starting line” has influenced Chinese parents for many years.
In recent years, another saying has become popular in parent circles in cities, ..
.. “In the era of relying on your father, your child has already lost at the starting line.”
This saying means that if parents have insufficient capacity, ..
.. their children’s starting point is already lower than that of other children.
Actually, this saying is a bit exaggerated.
Taking China’s first-tier cities as an example, although most parents are in the salaried class, ..
.. their family’s quality of life is not bad at all, ..
.. and their financial position absolutely can meet their children’s educational expenses.
Therefore, through this saying, we can see Chinese parents’ anxiety for their children to succeed in life.
Parents use various methods in order to help their children catch up from the so-called low starting point.
Of these, the most common is training classes, and there are numerous kinds of training classes.
The three major subjects, mathematics, Chinese, and English are indispensable, ..
.. and there is also painting, music, sports, computing, etc.
From kindergarten to high school graduation, almost every child living in cities will attend training classes.
Even kids who are just over one year old have also started to attend training classes to learn languages, painting, etc.
As well as attending classes, kids also get up early and come home late on weekends.
Some kids even get up at 6:30 am, spend the whole day in training classes, and don’t get home until after 7:00 pm.
Not only are the kids rushing from one training class to another, their parents’ time is also completely occupied.
Even so, parents still do not tire of it, ..
.. since they believe that only through continuous study can their children improve, and become outstanding people.
Many people think that the occurrence of this situation is rooted in excessively intense competition nowadays.
Parents have no choice but to force their kids to learn more knowledge; otherwise, they may be eliminated by society.
No matter what, we hope that parents can relax and ease the pressure on themselves and their children a little, ..
.. so that their children can enjoy their childhood.
